verdict.rationale: LocalAI is a self-hosted AI runtime and API server, so outbound event webhooks are a fair capability to ask about. Nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks or event subscriptions. The pack covers OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs, MCP client connections, agents and distributed nodes, none of which are webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
